title: APT28 - MITRE ATT&CK
raw_text: APT28 is a publicly tracked threat group also known as Fancy Bear and Sofacy. Public reporting links APT28 activity to phishing techniques and malware such as X-Agent. Reports describe APT28 targeting government and military organizations, including activity related to Ukraine.
